flows:
Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/signup then Type "Kane Tester" into the Full name field
Type "kaneowooco@mlyfo.app" into the Email field
Type "kaneowooco" into the Username field
Assert the username message contains "@kaneowooco is free"
Type "kane-password-123" into the Password field
Click "Create account"
Assert the page heading says "Welcome, Kane"
Assert the wallet balance shows "$500.00"

type: Entering kane-password-123 into the Password field

summary:
Completed the requested registration using the name Kane Tester, email kaneowooco@mlyfo.app, and username kaneowooco.
Confirmed that @kaneowooco was available, then entered the requested password and created the account.
The new account opened successfully with the heading “Welcome, Kane” and a wallet balance of $500.00.
